chapterInfo.content:
1
AWURADE asɔrefie no sie
1 # Esra 4.24; 5.1-2 Ɔhene Dario afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, bosome a ɛtɔ so nsia no da a ɛdi kan no, AWURADE asɛm nam Odiyifoɔ Hagai so baa Yuda Amrado Serubabel a ɔyɛ Sealtiel ba ne Ɔsɔfopanin Yosua a ɔyɛ Yehosadak ba nkyɛn sɛ: 2Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɔman yi ka sɛ: Ɛnya nnuruu berɛ a wɔde bɛsi AWURADE fie no. 3Na AWURADE asɛm nam Odiyifoɔ Hagai so baa sɛ: 4#2 Sa 7.2 Mo deɛ, ɛberɛ aduru ama mo sɛ motete mo adan a wɔaduradura mu mu, wɔ berɛ a efie yi deɛ, ayɛ dantuo yi? 5Na afei sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Monwenwene sɛdeɛ nnoɔma si rekɔ wɔ mo asetena mu ho yie. 6#Hag 2.16; Deut 28.38 Modua pii, nanso ketewa bi na monya firi mu; modidi, nanso mommee, monom nsa, nanso ɛnso mo; mofirafira ntoma, nanso mo ho nyɛ mo hye na ɔpaani apaadeɛ gu fotoɔ a wɔafiti ɛtoɔ mu.
7Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Afei monwenwene mo akwan ho yie, 8na momforo bepɔ nkɔfa nnua mmra mfa mmɛsi dan no, na ɛbɛyɛ me fɛ, na mayi m’animuonyam makyerɛ, AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 9Mohwɛɛ adeɛ pii kwan, na hwɛ, ayɛ ketewa. Na mode baa efie, na mehuu mu. Ɛdeɛn ntira? Asafo AWURADE asɛm nie. Me fie a ayɛ dantuo ntira, na mo deɛ, motu mmirika kɔ mo afie. 10#1 Ah 17.1 Saa nti, mo nti na ɔsoro akame, sɛ ɔbosuo nntɔ, na asase akame ne nnɔbaeɛ. 11#Hag 2.17; Amos 4.9 Na mefrɛɛ ɛweɛ baa asase so, mmepɔ so, ayuo so, nsamono so, ngo so, adeɛ a asase de ba so, nnipa so, afieboa so ne nsa ano brɛ adwuma nyinaa so.
12Ɛnna Sealtiel ba Serubabel ne Yehosadak ba Ɔsɔfopanin Yosua ne ɔman no nkaeɛ no nyinaa tiee AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn ne Odiyifoɔ Hagai nsɛm, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn somaa no no, na ɔman no suroo AWURADE anim. 13#Mal 2.7 Ɛnna Hagai, AWURADE bɔfoɔ no, bɔɔ AWURADE kaseɛ kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Medi mo akyi, AWURADE asɛm nie. 14Na AWURADE kanyann Sealtiel ba Serubabel, Yuda amrado no honhom, ne Yehosadak ba Yosua, ɔsɔfo panin no honhom, ne ɔman no nkaeɛ nyinaa ahonhom, na wɔba bɛyɛɛ adwuma, asafo AWURADE, wɔn Nyankopɔn fie, 15bosome a ɛtɔ so nsia no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnan no so, Ɔhene Dario afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɔhene Dario afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, bosome a ɛtɔ so nsia no da a ɛdi kan no, AWURADE asɛm nam Odiyifoɔ Hagai so baa Yuda Amrado Serubabel a ɔyɛ Sealtiel ba ne Ɔsɔfopanin Yosua a ɔyɛ Yehosadak ba nkyɛn sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɔman yi ka sɛ: Ɛnya nnuruu berɛ a wɔde bɛsi AWURADE fie no. Na AWURADE asɛm nam Odiyifoɔ Hagai so baa sɛ: Mo deɛ, ɛberɛ aduru ama mo sɛ motete mo adan a wɔaduradura mu mu, wɔ berɛ a efie yi deɛ, ayɛ dantuo yi? Na afei sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Monwenwene sɛdeɛ nnoɔma si rekɔ wɔ mo asetena mu ho yie. Modua pii, nanso ketewa bi na monya firi mu; modidi, nanso mommee, monom nsa, nanso ɛnso mo; mofirafira ntoma, nanso mo ho nyɛ mo hye na ɔpaani apaadeɛ gu fotoɔ a wɔafiti ɛtoɔ mu.
Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Afei monwenwene mo akwan ho yie, na momforo bepɔ nkɔfa nnua mmra mfa mmɛsi dan no, na ɛbɛyɛ me fɛ, na mayi m’animuonyam makyerɛ, AWURADE na ɔseɛ. Mohwɛɛ adeɛ pii kwan, na hwɛ, ayɛ ketewa. Na mode baa efie, na mehuu mu. Ɛdeɛn ntira? Asafo AWURADE asɛm nie. Me fie a ayɛ dantuo ntira, na mo deɛ, motu mmirika kɔ mo afie. Saa nti, mo nti na ɔsoro akame, sɛ ɔbosuo nntɔ, na asase akame ne nnɔbaeɛ. Na mefrɛɛ ɛweɛ baa asase so, mmepɔ so, ayuo so, nsamono so, ngo so, adeɛ a asase de ba so, nnipa so, afieboa so ne nsa ano brɛ adwuma nyinaa so.
Ɛnna Sealtiel ba Serubabel ne Yehosadak ba Ɔsɔfopanin Yosua ne ɔman no nkaeɛ no nyinaa tiee AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn ne Odiyifoɔ Hagai nsɛm, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn somaa no no, na ɔman no suroo AWURADE anim. Ɛnna Hagai, AWURADE bɔfoɔ no, bɔɔ AWURADE kaseɛ kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Medi mo akyi, AWURADE asɛm nie. Na AWURADE kanyann Sealtiel ba Serubabel, Yuda amrado no honhom, ne Yehosadak ba Yosua, ɔsɔfo panin no honhom, ne ɔman no nkaeɛ nyinaa ahonhom, na wɔba bɛyɛɛ adwuma, asafo AWURADE, wɔn Nyankopɔn fie, bosome a ɛtɔ so nsia no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnan no so, Ɔhene Dario afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
